lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's San Miguel County commissioners meeting, where four proposed Land Use Code amendments get individual public hearings — including new rules on forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal operations that would add an entirely new Natural Resources article to county code. Also worth your attention: Telluride's HARC takes up the large-scale Shandoka Lot redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd on Tuesday, and the school board's monthly meeting Monday revisits the mill levy override funding question that's been running through recent sessions.
